rationale: Builds directly on the current 9x512 recurrent-tail winner without changing the architecture, batch shape, or FP16 keep budget. The best script already smooths float-kept tensors and projection weights late in training, but one recurrent-tail attention value matrix still quantizes cold at save time. This change extends the late EMA set to recurrent-tail `attn.c_v.weight` tensors that remain quantized, targeting the exact final int8+zlib roundtrip metric with essentially zero byte cost and no hot-loop compile churn. I also compressed a few unchanged call sites to keep the script comfortably under the 1500-line cap.
title: Recurrent-Tail V EMA Smoothing
